title: Lift Scans Standing on a Granite Ridge Pass Account and the Component Retained for Them
content:
| Lift scan entries standing on the pass account | Component retained in addition |
| --- | --- |
| at least 6 | the tier's day use deduction, retained once |
| at least 1 but fewer than 6 | half the tier's day use deduction, a share of 50 per cent of it |
| none | nothing further on this account |

The schedule above governs the component retained for lift scans on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass given up. Where the pass account shows at least 6 lift scan entries, the tier's day use deduction is retained once in addition. Where the pass account shows at least 1 lift scan entry but fewer than 6, half the tier's day use deduction is retained in addition. In any other case nothing further is retained for the lift scans the pass account shows.

Note 1. The count is of lift scan entries standing on the pass account. The component is retained once however far above 6 that count runs; it is not retained for each entry. At 5 entries the component is half the deduction and at 6 it is the whole of it.

Note 2. The day use deduction is the figure published for the tier, and the component is added to the figure the shares have produced.

Note 3, worked on hypothetical accounts. A Granite Ridge Local Pass carries a day use deduction of 109.00. An account on that tier showing 9 lift scan entries has 109.00 retained in addition; one showing 3 entries has half of 109.00, which is 54.50, retained in addition; and one showing none has nothing retained on this account.
